scope: Owner-approved isolated precision experiment, not integration or confirmation.
unchanged: Same direct residual covariance estimator, models, point seed, inference seeds, saved outcome seeds, solver/rank/positivity/spectral/interval gates and stability/calibration screens as V1.
veneto: Twelve calls: q0 and q1 at each inference seed 8675309 through 8675314; compare all six seeds at 512 and 2048, with no seed selection.
saved_outcomes: Same eight V1 primary cells, replications 0 through 199 inclusive; 1600 new candidate calls, compared with both preserved V1 arms. All four targets accounted for; original primary eligibility retained.
prerequisites: Exact small-matrix comparison at both probe budgets and all six seeds; one saved-draw preflight in every selected cell; subset-reporting tests including known failures, RMS versus mean SE, original q1 covariance exclusion, corrupt/missing/duplicate record rejection, and deliberate CLI failures before main execution.
exact_matrix_check: Two independent dense worker-firm fixtures, with and without a control; compare dimension-three moment matrices to exact Z prime (M elementwise squared) Z under the same probes. Report every error; do not demand monotone improvement for every random draw.
screens: Use the V1 registered six-seed CV, endpoint range, floor share, availability, nominal-based lower coverage, SD/RMS-SE and paired coverage-drop screens unchanged. Main comparison is against V1 current_unified_subtractive; report changes against V1 candidate_direct_residual as well.
stop: Any failed screen prevents integration. No automatic higher probe count, threshold change, ridge, alternative fitter, new outcome draws, paper promotion or release.
